dedupe_keys.name: latvian state roads road weather station observations 2001 to 2022 air and road surface temperature precipitation wind visibility

description: Latvijas Valsts ceļi, the state company that manages the Latvian national road network, publishes the historical record of its road weather information stations on the national open data portal. Contents: the station messages by year from 2001 onward, with road surface and air temperature, surface condition, precipitation, humidity, wind speed and direction and visibility as reported by the stations along state roads; a field description document explains and translates the message data items, and yearly archives for 2021 and 2022 were added after the main archive. Producer: Latvijas Valsts ceļi, which runs the station network for winter maintenance and traffic information. Coverage: state roads across Latvia, from 2001 to 2022. Format and access: a combined ZIP of yearly CSV files of about 906 MB for 2001 to 2020 on the company's data server, plus ZIP archives of 87 MB and 75 MB for 2021 and 2022, with no registration. Licence: Creative Commons CC0. Caveats: the archive stops in 2022, station lists and sensors change over the years, and station coordinates must be joined from the separate station list; live data now run through the national access point transportdata.gov.lv. Simulation uses: winter road condition and icing models, weather-related accident and closure analysis, and calibrating climate impacts on road maintenance. Related records: the TEN-T network maps (data-eu-ten-t-network-tentec) show the Latvian corridor roads that many stations sit on.
